records.title: Wireless Network Intelligence at the Edge
records.reason: The primary abstract surveys distributed edge ML and explicitly discusses low latency, resource constraints, and collective training/inference, but it does not establish a concrete LLM-serving method or measured LLM efficiency result.

records.title: A Survey on Large Language Models: Applications, Challenges, Limitations, and Practical Usage
records.reason: TechRxiv’s publisher abstract identifies this stable Semantic Scholar candidate as the DOI-linked general LLM survey. It synthesizes history, architecture, training and applications and lists computational-resource requirements as a challenge, without a concrete inference/runtime efficiency method.

records.title: LongVLM: Efficient Long Video Understanding via Large Language Models
records.reason: LongVLM uses hierarchical token merging to encode local video features across segments; this is a concrete visual-token compression mechanism that makes long-video LLM input more affordable, although its demonstrated task is video understanding.

records.title: THOR: Secure Transformer Inference with Homomorphic Encryption
records.reason: THOR develops packed homomorphic matrix multiplication and approximated transformer nonlinearities; its abstract reports 5.3×/9.7× kernel speedups and secure BERT inference, directly improving private transformer inference.

records.title: BumbleBee: Secure Two-party Inference Framework for Large Transformers
records.reason: BumbleBee is a two-party private transformer-inference system; the publisher abstract reports 80–95% communication reductions and over 10× speedup versus prior systems, directly targeting inference latency and communication.

records.title: SIGMA: Secure GPT Inference with Function Secret Sharing
records.reason: SIGMA builds GPU-accelerated function-secret-sharing protocols for transformer operations and reports 11–19× lower secure-inference latency, with Llama 2 13B inference in 44 seconds.

records.title: Thinking with Video: Video Generation as a Promising Multimodal Reasoning Paradigm
records.reason: The primary abstract introduces a video-generation reasoning paradigm and evaluates task accuracy; it does not describe a model-execution efficiency method or resource reduction.

records.title: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
records.reason: Continual Harness improves embodied-agent task progress and button-press cost through online harness refinement; the abstract does not identify reduced model inference latency, tokens, memory, or serving resources.

records.title: AI-Driven Real-Time Monitoring of Cardiovascular Conditions With Wearable Devices: Scoping Review
records.reason: The JMIR review surveys wearable cardiovascular monitoring applications and deployment challenges. It does not contribute an LLM inference or serving efficiency method.

records.title: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis
records.reason: OpenResearcher is an offline corpus and trajectory-synthesis pipeline for training deep-research agents; its contribution concerns training data and reproducibility, not model inference/deployment efficiency.

records.title: PUMA: Secure Inference of LLaMA-7B in Five Minutes
records.reason: PUMA proposes secure transformer inference protocols with approximations that reduce computation and communication by 20–76%; it reports LLaMA-7B one-token generation in under five minutes.

records.title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
records.reason: MinerU2.5-Pro focuses on data engineering, training, and document-parsing quality; the primary abstract does not establish a contribution to general LLM runtime or deployment efficiency.

records.title: HealthBench Professional: Evaluating Large Language Models on Real Clinician Chats
records.reason: HealthBench Professional evaluates clinical-chat quality and clinician alignment. Its primary abstract is about capability evaluation, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: SkillFlow:Benchmarking Lifelong Skill Discovery and Evolution for Autonomous Agents
records.reason: SkillFlow benchmarks lifelong skill discovery and evolution for agents; the abstract describes success/capability evaluation and gives no model execution-cost contribution.

records.title: HyPar: Towards Hybrid Parallelism for Deep Learning Accelerator Array
records.reason: HyPar studies hybrid parallelism and communication for deep-learning accelerator arrays. These are systems techniques with a possible connection to distributed model execution, but the primary abstract focuses on accelerator/training workloads and does not establish an LLM inference result.

records.title: Coupling Macro Dynamics and Micro States for Long-Horizon Social Simulation
records.reason: The paper improves long-horizon social simulation capacity through macro/micro state modeling; its contribution is application modeling rather than LLM inference or deployment efficiency.

records.title: Dolphin-v2: Universal Document Parsing via Scalable Anchor Prompting
records.reason: Dolphin-v2 combines document-type/layout analysis with layout-guided element-wise parallel parsing for digital documents; the primary abstract and methodology call this efficient inference through parallel processing. This is a concrete VLM execution-pipeline improvement in a specialized parsing workload.
records.body_check: official HTML https://arxiv.org/html/2602.05384; Abstract and Sections I, III, lines 41-44, 64-67, 110-112 checked. The paper states digital documents use layout-anchor-guided element-wise parallel parsing and reports efficient inference through parallel processing; no general-purpose LLM serving benchmark was identified. Paper not fully read.

records.title: RHO: Your Coding Agent is Secretly a Roboticist
records.reason: RHO reports fewer tool calls and shorter wall-clock time for a coding agent controlling a robot. This is a system-level agent efficiency signal, but the abstract does not isolate model inference cost or establish general serving/runtime improvements.

records.title: Advancing Underwater Vision: A Survey of Deep Learning Models for Underwater Object Recognition and Tracking
records.reason: The verified IEEE title identifies an underwater-object-recognition survey, a distinct vision application; no LLM inference-system contribution is indicated by the title. IEEE Xplore’s official page required JavaScript/robot verification, so only title screening was used.

records.title: Reasoning via Video: The First Evaluation of Video Models' Reasoning Abilities through Maze-Solving Tasks
records.reason: The primary abstract introduces and evaluates video-model reasoning on maze tasks; it reports task capability rather than a model-execution efficiency contribution.
